title: Quigli
summary: Quigli calls his crew when a monk accepts the challenge.
overview: Quigli calls his crew when a monk accepts the challenge.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: The eligible monk can choose the crew fight through dialogue.
The first crew arrives five seconds after the challenge begins.
Collect the lackey, swabbies and scallywag while keeping pressure on Quigli.
Finish inside the fifteen-minute encounter window.
